posts.label: Market Update
posts.alt: Scottsdale market update post: buyers paid 96% of asking
posts.caption: Scottsdale buyers paid about 96% of asking in September. Sale to list price was 96.4%, and the median home sold for about $890K over the three months to September, up 9.2% from a year ago. Prices are firm, with room to talk on the right home. #ScottsdaleAZ #ScottsdaleRealEstate

posts.label: Seller Tip
posts.alt: Your front door is the first showing seller tip post
posts.caption: Selling soon? Buyers judge your home from the curb in seconds, and most see it first in your listing photos. Fresh paint, healthy plants and a working porch light go a long way. #ScottsdaleAZ #SellingYourHome
